create.name: Tsegyalgar East (International Dzogchen Community)
create.bio:
Tsegyalgar East is the North American home of the International Dzogchen Community, the worldwide network of practitioners gathered by the Tibetan master Chögyal Namkhai Norbu, whose teaching is carried on today by Namkhai Yeshi. It is based in Conway, a small town in the hills of western Massachusetts, where a large multi-purpose building stands beside a gonpa, or practice hall. Twelve miles away in Buckland lies Khandroling, 220 acres of hilltop meadow and forest bought by the community in 1989, with a white stupa, personal retreat cabins and an open-sided pavilion that shelters the first Universal Mandala built for the Vajra Dance. The name Tsegyalgar can be translated as 'victorious peak of pure and total presence'.

The programme follows Namkhai Norbu's teaching of Dzogchen alongside the practices he passed on: the Vajra Dance, Yantra Yoga and the Khaita joyful dances. Weekend retreats led by senior instructors are held in Conway and streamed online, some open only to those who have received transmission from Namkhai Norbu or Namkhai Yeshi, while others, such as guided sessions of Tibetan dream yoga, are open to anyone. Vajra Dance practitioners meet every Saturday, and many weekly practices run on Zoom for members, with interpretation into several languages.

courses.title: Tibetan Dream Yoga with Michael Katz
courses.description: An online session on Tibetan dream yoga, the practice of staying aware through sleep, including a guided nap. Open to the public, on Zoom, with interpretation into several languages; no recording.

courses.title: Relating to Basic Space: Longde retreat with Steven Landsberg
courses.description: A weekend retreat on the Longde or 'space' series of Dzogchen teachings, in person at Tsegyalgar East and online, with two sessions a day. Requires prior transmission from Namkhai Norbu or Namkhai Yeshi; sessions are recorded.

free_resources.title: Saturday Vajra Dance practice
free_resources.description: Weekly Saturday practice days for anyone who already knows the Vajra Dance, at the Conway gonpa or on the Universal Mandala at Khandroling; come for as long as you like.
